description: Source file for a plugin module related to harvester components in a software project, including initialization, support check, and unload functions, with registration of various interface functions.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers functions, and creates harvester object.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if an object is supported (always returns true).

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads the plugin and removes the harvester object.
